summary: Team Faz 2 (Overdue Cron + Heat Map) fully verified. Backend: 52/52 pytest PASS (test_permissions 20 + test_tasks 22 + test_team_faz2 10). Frontend: bell + badge + popover + heatmap all working across mgr_test / emp1_test / ahmet. No regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend scan-now endpoint reports {tasks_seen, self, manager} aggregate counts — good for smoke debugging. Consider also returning per-task_id delta so front-end tests can pin idempotency to a specific task without inspecting the full notifications list.

notifications dedup relies on unique index over (user_id, task_id, type) with a partial filter on task_id str; works but be aware that deleting a task does NOT cascade-delete existing notification rows (documented in agent_to_agent_context_note). If overdue task is later completed/deleted, stale 'overdue' notifications remain in user history. Not blocking; suggest a cascade on task delete or a mark_task_resolved sweep in the scanner tick.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (bell visible for all authenticated users; mgr badge = 12; popover 'BİLDİRİMLER (23)' with correct manager-fanout copy 'emp1_test kullanıcısının görevi geciktirmesi'; single-read badge 12→11; mark-all → badge gone; popover close via notification-close OK; team-heatmap-emp1_test grid 30/60/90 cells respectively; cell title 'YYYY-MM-DD · N tamamlandı'; employees/ahmet see bell but no tab-team)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Team Faz 2 is fully green.
